end_wall_in_from_grid_m.source: docs/moxir/AERIAL_2026-10-07.md (rows 'Bays / length' and 'End walls'); moxir-aerial-2026-10-07.json result.length_m 108.2 +- 0.6 and model_corrections.end_wall_outer_face_z_m mean 54.1
end_wall_in_from_grid_m.method: roof edge to roof edge along the hall in both captures (108.2, 108.25). The outer face sits at 108.2 / 2 = 54.1 from the centre. hall.py puts the inner face at L/2 + this key and the wall is 0.3 m thick, so 54.0 + (-0.2) + 0.3 = 54.1. The 6 m grid, 18 bays and the column axes stay; the end columns are clipped flush with the outer face (Soviet practice sets end columns 0.5 m in from the end grid line, with the wall on the line; that is NOT applied here because no picture shows it)

crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.confidence: medium (photo metrology, not taped). Per crane: far crane (76.2 m from the door) MEASURED by photo; near crane (49.2 m, over the DJ) ASSUMED the same type

suspected.solar_roof: SUSPECTED: since 2024 (capture 2024-08-22) a solar plant covers the roof: ~40 panel rows over spans 1 and 4 and panels on or inside the lantern frames. The lanterns' daylight (the emissive 'skylight' material in hall.py) may be partly blocked; the model still draws the lanterns open. A dark lattice band along the nave's right row (x +12) and across spans 2-3 at the joint: stripped deck, cable trays or walkways, unknown. Owed to the 10-08 visit: one photo straight up at x +12 and one at z 0.
